title: The Midnight Thorn
premise: Ivo Kavanagh, a mercenary bound by oath to the silent god Veyra, has spent years guiding smugglers through the Thornfell mountains while hiding his gift of reading memories in touched objects. When the crown declares a hunt for all gifted souls, Ivo is captured and forced to serve the very king who signed the decree — only to discover the monarch's mind is slowly devoured by a memory-eating entity wearing his crown like a parasite. With the last dragon-fire — the only force that can unbind such a thing — guttering in a dying dragon beneath Thornfell, Ivo must choose between loyalty to his sworn brothers-in-arms, who profit from the hunt, and the truth that could free the kingdom. He leads a desperate ascent through the mountains, sacrifices his own stored memories to feed the dying flame, and burns the crown-entity away; the king, freed but broken, abolishes the hunt, and Ivo walks into exile carrying only one memory he refused to surrender.
about_author: Rafael Oyelaran is a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping mountain passes across three continents before turning to fiction. He writes fantasy rooted in landscapes that feel lived-in, where oaths matter more than magic.

chapters.title: Salt on the Pass
chapters.summary: Ivo guides a smuggler caravan through Thornfell, using his secret gift to read a locket and expose a traitor among them. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: quiet competence shadowed by loneliness — his god has been silent for seven years, and he wonders if his gift is a punishment rather than a blessing.

chapters.title: The King's Decree
chapters.summary: In the lowland city of Corvess, criers announce the Crown Hunt: all gifted persons to be seized for 'examination.' Ivo's old comrade Bren offers him sanctuary with their mercenary company — which has taken crown coin to run the hunts. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: betrayal's first sting; loyalty begins to fracture.

chapters.title: What the Chains Remember
chapters.summary: Captured at a checkpoint, Ivo reads the shackles' history and learns prisoners are being drained of memories to feed something in the palace. He is dragged before the king himself. POV: Ivo, with a brief interlude from a terrified prisoner. Emotional beat: dread hardening into resolve as he glimpses the wrongness behind the throne.

chapters.title: The Thing Wearing the Crown
chapters.summary: Alone with the king, Ivo touches the royal seal and sees the truth: an ancient entity called the Hollow Regent, bound into the crown generations ago, devouring its wearer's mind. The king, lucid for one flickering moment, begs for release. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: horrified compassion — justice outside the law becomes personal.

chapters.title: Brothers in Coin
chapters.summary: Bren discovers Ivo's survival and offers to smuggle him out of the kingdom — if Ivo swears silence about what he saw. Their argument in a rain-soaked tavern splits the mercenary company down the middle. POV: alternating Ivo and Bren. Emotional beat: grief; both men are right by their own codes.

chapters.title: The Last Dragon
chapters.summary: Ivo flees into Thornfell seeking the dragon Emberveil, whose fading fire is the only force that can unmake the Hollow Regent. He finds her ancient, half-blind, and dying in a hidden caldera. POV: Ivo, then Emberveil. Emotional beat: awe tempered by urgency — the flame has weeks, not months.

chapters.title: The Price of Fire
chapters.summary: Emberveil reveals the cost: her fire must be fed memories freely given, and she is too weak to carry it far. Ivo begins surrendering his most treasured recollections — his mother's face, his god's voice — storing them in a thorn-iron casket. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: sacrifice as slow amputation; each memory costs more than the last.

chapters.title: The Hunt Closes
chapters.summary: Bren, ordered to flush rebels from Thornfell, corners Ivo at the caldera's mouth. Instead of fighting, Bren reads the casket's residue and finally believes him. Half the company defects; the rest sound the alarm to the palace. POV: Bren. Emotional beat: redemption bought too late to be clean — loyalty realigned toward truth.

chapters.title: Crownfire
chapters.summary: The climax: Ivo and the defectors fight through the palace as Emberveil makes her final flight. In the throne room, Ivo feeds the last of his stored memories to the dragon-fire and presses the burning flame against the crown. The Hollow Regent screams itself apart; the king collapses, freed and hollowed. Emberveil falls from the sky, spent. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: triumph laced with irrevocable loss.

chapters.title: One Memory Kept
chapters.summary: The broken king abolishes the hunt and names no heroes. Ivo refuses reward, opens the casket, and finds a single memory survived intact: the sound of his god saying his name — proof the silence was never abandonment. He walks north into the mountains as the first snow falls. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace; justice done, identity rebuilt from what remains.
